column1: # The S8 fixture tree (spec, Fixtures: "Fixture tree"), written by hand. kit-fixtures.sh build tree makes exactly these
# files under $KIT_ROOT/fixtures/tree/ (plus the .git folder of repo/, made by git init); expect listing tree checks the
# folder against this table. Every excluded case of the spec is present at least once. Columns, separated by one tab:
# path (under tree/), kind, argument. Names hold no space. The key and password files hold only made-up text, never a real key.
# Kinds: jpeg N and png N (copy of generated picture N: jpeg 1-4, png 1-2), text <line>, lines <line>|<line>|... (one
#   odt <line>, pdf <line> (one page; no parenthesis or backslash in the line), wav (1 s tone), mp4 (1 s clip),
#   sparse <bytes> (a size and no blocks on disk: the cloud-only stand-in), noise <bytes>:<seed> (random-looking bytes),
#   trunc <png1|png2|pdf|mp4>:<bytes> (the first bytes of that generated file: a damaged file), badbytes (bytes that are not text).
# Top-level folders, each one picked as one folder by the recipes except never-picked:
#   plain        ordinary files of every kind, none of them excluded
#   excluded     key and password names, hidden folders, Caches, an app bundle, a cloud-only stand-in
#   unsupported  .pptx .xlsx .pages .dng and a file with no extension, next to two readable files
#   damaged      one damaged file of each kind, next to one good file of each kind
#   repo         a git repo (.gitignore, node_modules, Pods, build, dist, .build, vendor, git-ignored files)
